title: apr serve omits the server timings block on the Qwen3.5 hybrid CUDA chat path, so replay TTFT/prefill/decode are null for apr
evidence: PRM-S1 review-replay-v1 set b8a58011 on gx10 (GB10, gpu-layers resolved=32/32 backend=cuda, server log 'qwen35 hybrid forward, #3090'), apr 0.69.5-rc.1 (5660b0877), Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M sha 00fe7986: 200/200 /v1/chat/completions replies have usage (input/output tokens) but no timings, so prompt_ms, prompt_tps and decode_tps are null in all 200 rows. llama.cpp d1d3c3396 on the same set and cell returns timings on 200/200. Timings::from_phases exists and cuda_chat_backend.rs builds PhaseTimings; the hybrid path apparently does not call it (suspected, not traced)
repro: apr serve run Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf --gpu-layers all --context-length 36864; POST /v1/chat/completions non-streaming; the reply JSON has no timings key

title: apr serve on the Qwen3.5-4B hybrid CUDA path is 4.6x slower wall-clock than llama.cpp d1d3c3396 on identical prompt ids (PRM-S1 v2)
evidence: PRM-S1 review-replay-v2 set a4910a65 (200 items, enable_thinking=false both sides) on gx10 GB10, Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M sha 00fe7986, apr 0.69.3 @96eb79f51 --gpu-layers all vs llama.cpp d1d3c3396 -ngl 99, ctx 36864, greedy seed 4354 max_tokens 512. Pre-run gate: prompt-ids sha llama=apr=66ef3684, ids-diff differ 0/200; input tokens 1,941,322 both. Wall p50 apr 26.84 s vs llama 5.85 s (4.59x); wall sum 6008 s vs 1248 s; wall per output token 131.8 ms vs 28.2 ms (4.68x; output tokens 45,573 vs 44,275). Peak RSS apr 8419 MB vs 9566 MB (0.88x). parse_rate 1.0; verdict agreement 195/200. apr server TTFT/prefill/decode are null (FND-20260926-serve-qwen35-gpu-no-timings), so the prefill-vs-decode split is not measured; llama prefill 3.7-4.1k tok/s, decode 63.5 tok/s.
repro: replay build --version review-replay-v2; replay prompt-ids per engine; replay ids-diff (exit 0); replay run --ids per engine; replay summary (set a4910a65, speed-block prompt_ids_sha f3c20136)
